cat << 'SCRIPT' > /root/contamcal-irt-calibration/scripts/seed0/sft_phi4_s0_sweep.sh
#!/bin/bash
# seed=0 version of run_phi4_s123.sh (Phase B)
set -x
TRAIN_SCRIPT=/root/contamcal-irt-calibration/exp001/train_sft.py
DATA_DIR=/root/autodl-tmp/sft_data
CKPT_DIR=/root/autodl-tmp/exp001/checkpoints
MODEL=/root/autodl-tmp/models/phi-4

export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0

for d in 000 005 025 050 100; do
  OUTDIR="${CKPT_DIR}/phi-4_d${d}_s0"
  if [ -f "${OUTDIR}/train_config.json" ]; then
    echo "=== SKIP phi-4 dosage=${d} seed=0 (already exists) ==="
    continue
  fi
  echo "=== Starting phi-4 dosage=${d} seed=0 at $(date) ==="
  HF_DATASETS_OFFLINE=1 HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1 \
  /root/miniconda3/bin/python "$TRAIN_SCRIPT" \
    --model-name "$MODEL" \
    --data-path "${DATA_DIR}/sft_dosage_${d}.jsonl" \
    --output-dir "$OUTDIR" \
    --seed 0 \
    --lora-r 16 --lora-alpha 32 --lr 5e-5 \
    --batch-size 1 --grad-accum 16
  echo "=== Finished phi-4 dosage=${d} seed=0 at $(date), exit code=$? ==="
done
echo "ALL_DONE_PHI4_S0"
SCRIPT
